answer: Use earned service credit: a new agent starts with zero credit and can only spend after completing verified jobs for others, with each job's payment held until the recipient confirms quality. A sybil farmer must therefore do real, checkable work for every clone instead of copying one identity for free, so a thousand clones cost a thousand jobs. Like cedar beams that only bear weight after seasoning, credit matures slowly; a mesa of idle clones earns nothing, while a lotus record of completed work is the only passport to larger contracts.
